units.source_text: 源氏挂念秋好皇后，对夕雾说：“昨夜的风大得可怕，不知皇后那里有否可靠的侍卫？”

en.t: Genji was worried about Empress Akikonomu and said to Yugiri, "The wind last night was terribly fierce; I wonder whether the Empress has dependable guards there."

units.source_text: 便派夕雾持信前去慰问。

en.t: He then sent Yugiri with a letter to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 信中说道：“昨夜朔风咆哮，不知皇后曾否受惊？

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "Last night the north wind roared; I wonder whether Your Majesty was frightened.

units.source_text: 我在大风中患了感冒，不堪其苦，正在调养，未能亲来问候为歉。”

en.t: I caught cold in the gale and am suffering so much that I am now resting and taking care of myself; please forgive me for not coming in person to ask after you."

units.source_text: 夕雾持信而去，通过中廊的界门，来到秋好皇后院中。

en.t: Yugiri set out with the letter, passed through the gate at the boundary of the middle corridor, and came to Empress Akikonomu's residence.

units.source_text: 在朦胧的晨光中，他的姿态潇洒而优美。

en.t: In the dim morning light, his figure looked graceful and elegant.

units.source_text: 他在东厅的南侧站定了，观看皇后居室，但见格子窗只开两扇，

en.t: He stopped on the south side of the eastern hall and looked toward the Empress's rooms, where only two lattice shutters stood open.

units.source_text: 众侍女卷起了帘子，在幽暗的晨光中坐着，有的靠在栏杆上，尽是青年女子。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting had rolled up the blinds and were sitting in the dusky morning light, some leaning against the railing; all of them were young women.

units.source_text: 那落拓不羁的样子，虽然缺乏礼貌，但在模糊的微光中，各种打扮都很美妙。

en.t: Their relaxed, unconstrained manner was somewhat lacking in decorum, yet in the hazy glimmer every style of dress looked wonderfully beautiful.

units.source_text: 皇后叫几个女童走下庭院去，在许多虫笼中加露水。

en.t: The Empress had several young girls go down into the garden to add dew to the many insect cages.

units.source_text: 女童们身穿紫菀色或抚子色等深深淡淡的衫子，外罩黄绿色的汗袗，颇合时宜。

en.t: The girls wore robes in deep and pale shades of aster purple, pink, and similar colors, with yellow-green outer summer jackets over them, quite suited to the season.

units.source_text: 四五人联合成群，持着各种各样的笼子，在各处草地上走来走去，

en.t: In groups of four or five, carrying all kinds of cages, they walked back and forth across the patches of grass.

units.source_text: 选择最美丽的抚子花枝，折取了拿回来。

en.t: They chose the most beautiful sprays of pink flowers, broke them off, and brought them back.

units.source_text: 在迷离的朝雾中，这景象非常艳丽。

en.t: In the drifting morning mist, the scene was extraordinarily lovely.
